[Thinking]
**Finding the last solar eclipse before 2000**

I'm looking for the last solar eclipse before the year 2000. I think it might be August 11, 1999, since there's also a partial eclipse in February that year. I should verify that it's the last one before the new millennium. If someone asks about the date, I want to mention it was the last one in 1999 depending on visibility. I can keep the answer concise and clear!
[/Thinking]

The last solar eclipse before the year 2000 was on **August 11, 1999** — a **total solar eclipse**.
